title: Korean Braised Short Ribs
description: Galbi jjim — short ribs braised until the meat gives up and slides off the bone, in a sauce built on grated pear rather than extra sugar. A holiday dish that rewards a slow afternoon.
notes: Better the next day. Cool the braise whole, lift the set fat off the top, and reheat gently.

ingredients.name: Asian pear
ingredients.note: peeled and grated; the enzyme is what tenderises

steps.text: Soak the short ribs in cold water, changing it once, to draw out the blood.
steps.tip: Skipping this is the difference between a clear braise and a muddy one.

steps.text: Parboil the ribs in fresh water, then drain and rinse each piece.
Blend the pear, garlic, and ginger with the soy sauce and brown sugar into a smooth braising liquid.
Return the ribs to the pot, pour over the liquid, and simmer covered on the lowest heat.
steps.tip: The meat should be pulling back from the bone before anything else goes in.

steps.text: Add the carrots, daikon, and shiitake and cook uncovered so the sauce reduces and glazes.
Turn off the heat, stir through the sesame oil, and scatter with spring onions.
